title: Repoint opum-workflow's marketplace source to explicit ref: main
summary: Step 4 of 5 in the user-approved main-branch migration -- the step that changes plugin resolution for all nine fleet sessions, announced to the fleet before starting per the standing rule. Changes marketplace.json's opum-workflow plugin entry from the bare string './' (implicit: tracks whatever ref the opum marketplace clone itself is checked out on, which today is dev) to an explicit {source: github, repo: opum-ai/opum-marketplace, ref: main} -- the same mechanism opum-lore and opum-quest already use against other repos with tag refs, proven working in this exact marketplace.json, now self-referential. dev stays the default branch, matching every sibling repo's own model (opum-doc's runbook: 'main | Never the default'); only opum-workflow's own content resolution becomes ref-scoped to main, giving it the same promoted-not-raw-tip property every other plugin here already has. Timed immediately after OMARK-31 deliberately: main and dev are identical right now (both 3d33da9), so this is a no-op in content and a real change in mechanism -- the ideal moment to verify, since nothing is lost if resolution breaks.

acceptanceCriteria.text: marketplace.json's opum-workflow entry uses the explicit github+ref source form, ref: main, landed via the normal dev branch/PR path.

After landing, run claude plugin marketplace update opum in this session and confirm installed_plugins.json's opum-workflow@opum gitCommitSha still resolves correctly -- matching main's tip, not left stale or broken. This is the live-resolution verification opum-agent asked for, isolated to the safest possible moment (main == dev).
Confirm opum-lore and opum-quest's entries are untouched -- they were never expected to be affected (already ref-pinned to tags in other repos), but confirm rather than assume.

If resolution breaks, the rollback is a plain revert of the marketplace.json change back to './' on dev, landed the normal way -- existing clones' dev tracking for the marketplace LISTING itself is never touched by this change, so a bad step 4 means 'opum-workflow does not update', not 'no session can resolve the marketplace'.

implementationNotes: Verified locally before pushing, against the real checker scripts (not just eyeballing shape): 'manifests OK (3 plugins)' from the exact node snippet ci.yml runs, and check-federated-pins.test.mjs's regression suite still 5/5. Confirmed scripts/check-federated-pins.mjs's live version-match check only fires for refs matching /^v/ (semver tags) -- opum-workflow's new ref: 'main' is a branch, so it is correctly SKIPPED by that check (same as the old './' form and same as any sha pin would be), same treatment opum-lore/opum-quest's real tag pins already get exercised against, live, on any PR touching marketplace.json. opum-lore and opum-quest entries confirmed untouched by this diff (only the opum-workflow object added, three keys changed).
